classifications.ENFORCEABLE: An independently supported mechanism prevents the specified action within the explicitly stated scope; not a claim about unobserved provider internals.
classifications.OBSERVABLE_ONLY: Available telemetry can expose a violation or report a count, without reliable prevention. Detection may itself be incomplete on errors.
classifications.UNKNOWN: Evidence is insufficient for either a prevention guarantee or complete observation.

evidence_kinds.D: Current first-party documentation, scoped to its actual promise; not a version-specific runtime proof.
evidence_kinds.I: Read-only installed binary/retained arguments or local implementation inspection.
evidence_kinds.E: Existing immutable V003 or previously authorised fictional observations; no new hosted probe.
evidence_kinds.A: Assumption or unresolved condition; never sufficient for ENFORCEABLE.

constraints.scope: Prevent a second parent-controlled dispatch of an already consumed slot
constraints.mechanism: Exclusive lock and durable single-use dispatch marker in frozen V003; tested refusal before client construction. A future V004 dispatcher would need the same audited mechanism.
constraints.limitation: One process invocation is not one model generation. No V004 real dispatcher exists.

constraints.scope: At most one visible assistant message generation per scientific attempt
constraints.controls: max-turns=1, retries=0, no tool formatter; count distinct message IDs and reprompt events
constraints.finding: V003 produced two distinct IDs despite the configured controls. Stream chunks sharing an ID are not new generations.
constraints.limitation: A stream observer can reject/stop after detection, not prove the next request was prevented.

constraints.scope: Proposed Path B: at most two visible generations, initial plus one append-only output-limit continuation
constraints.finding: Count all distinct visible IDs and retain ordered original text. A second generation is eligible only with evidenced same-attempt output-limit continuation; third/unexplained generations and schema/semantic repair are deviations.
constraints.limitation: This is a proposed post-hoc compliance rule, not a claim that the CLI prevents a third or invisible request; no new probe validates it.

constraints.scope: Count/prevent every underlying provider request, including invisible helpers or retries
constraints.finding: Stream request IDs are a visible lower bound; no complete wire log or universal pre-request interception guarantee was established.

constraints.scope: Prevent automatic output-limit continuation or model regeneration within the CLI
constraints.finding: V003 exposes an output-limit notice followed by a second model response. No documented independently supported universal off switch was established.
constraints.limitation: Undocumented variable names in a binary do not establish supported semantics.

constraints.scope: Prevent the parent application from calling a model to repair/replace/retry a response
constraints.mechanism: One parent call per durable slot, local-only validation and no repair/fallback call path; mocked call-count tests.
constraints.limitation: Does not prevent the CLI's internal generation loops.

constraints.scope: Prevent the StructuredOutput validation/reprompt loop while using raw JSON
constraints.controls: Omit --json-schema, pass empty tools, verify initialization and zero tool calls
constraints.finding: This removes the selected formatter interface and prior raw probe had zero formatting calls. It does not certify absence of other internal regeneration.
constraints.limitation: If --json-schema is used, documented validation reprompting is incompatible with claiming every repair is local formatting.

constraints.scope: Prevent combined ordinary input + cache creation + cache reads + output exceeding 60000 per attempt
constraints.finding: No independently certified complete-input/scaffolding/request-count/output bound was established. Combined reported excess can be detected after dispatch; increasing the allowance does not itself create prevention.
constraints.limitation: No separate scientific input/output cap. Approximately 20000 output tokens is only a planning guide; thinking is not added to output again.

constraints.scope: Observe and reconcile ordinary, cache-write and cache-read input counts
constraints.finding: Sum the three terminal components once, reconcile against per-model totals and deduplicated assistant input counts when available. Do not add cache subdetails again.
constraints.limitation: Some error results can omit/zero usage. A consistent report is not independent proof of all provider work.

constraints.scope: Observe output and available thinking subcounts
constraints.finding: Use final result/model usage for output; assistant-event output is a placeholder. Preserve thinking detail separately without adding it twice.
constraints.limitation: Missing/conflicting fields and crashes leave completeness UNKNOWN; list-price estimates are not subscription charges.

constraints.scope: Independently verify token totals for all provider activity
constraints.finding: Neither a subscription invoice nor complete provider-request telemetry is available. Local arithmetic cannot certify unobserved activity.

constraints.scope: Prevent malformed, missing-usage or observed-deviating output being labelled compliant
constraints.mechanism: Strict local JSON/schema/semantic checks, multiple-fault accounting and explicit UNKNOWN rejection; preserve originals and fixed denominators.
constraints.limitation: Acceptance control cannot undo consumption, prevent a CLI request or certify economic merit.

constraints.scope: Observe per-file/default-state metadata changes in a monitored window
constraints.finding: Metadata-only per-file snapshots and process-lifetime samples can reject contaminated windows. A separate development Claude process was present in the prior investigation.
constraints.limitation: No prior per-file baseline was retained for that window; writer attribution remains UNKNOWN. Stat equality cannot prove content equality or exclude between-sample changes.

constraints.scope: Prove which process changed historical .claude.json metadata or prove credential leakage
constraints.finding: Existing end-of-window boolean plus later stat/process observations cannot establish causation or leakage. No credential contents are inspected.

constraints.scope: Attribute actual subscription charges to one attempt
constraints.finding: Reported token counts and CLI list-price estimates do not establish actual incremental subscription charges. Record charges only if independently observable and attributable; otherwise UNKNOWN, never zero or fee proration.

strict_path_A: BLOCKED: strict prevention of one generation and the revised combined 60000-token allowance is not established.
exploratory_path_B: PROPOSED_ONLY: whole-workflow comparison, common combined 60000-token allowance with post-hoc compliance, nonbinding approximately 20000-output planning guide and proposed maximum two visible generations with one evidenced append-only continuation. No schema repair or complete-answer regeneration; not equivalent to Path A.
revision_reason: Owner requested one combined 60000-token allowance and a nonbinding output planning guide; prevention findings remain unchanged. Path B now proposes bounded visible output-limit continuation.
